objects.text: PS1 · SITOP PSU100C INPUT AND OUTPUT
L, N and PE route to XT3 on A2/011. Upstream source and protection remain outside the example.
PS1 is Siemens 6EP1332-5BA00. Use its source record for the input and output ratings.
XT1 · TWO-BRANCH DC DISTRIBUTION
Right-hand cross-references route supply to B1 and B2. Branch protection and conductor sizing are outside this example.
B1 · ifm IFS204 inductive sensor power wiring
B1 switching output goes through XT5 to A1 DI a.0 on A2/005.
The +24 V and 0 V feeds arrive from XT1 through XT5 on A2/014.
B2 · ifm PN2070 pressure sensor power wiring
B2 OUT2 and OUT1 route separately through XT4 on A2/013. The model assumes voltage and PNP switching modes.
The +24 V and 0 V conductors connect through XT1 on A2/002.
A1 · CPU 1212C POWER AND I/O
B1 OUT maps to DI a.0 / I0.0 at X10:7. Input group reference 1M returns to 0 V.
B2 OUT2 maps to AI0 at X11:2. Analog reference 2M returns to 0 V.
The analog connection assumes PN2070 OUT2 is configured for 0–10 V. Its factory mode is 4–20 mA.
Q0.0 drives K1 on A2/006. I0.1 reads the KM1 auxiliary contact on A2/007. PLC logic is outside scope.
K1 · PLC OUTPUT INTERFACE RELAY
A1 X12:3 / DQ a.0 / Q0.0 feeds K1:A1. K1:A2 returns to the SITOP 0 V net.
X12:1 / 3L+ feeds the transistor outputs. X12:2 / 3M returns to 0 V.
K1 NO 11–14 routes to KM1 on A2/007. K1 NC 11–12 reports through XT2:3 on A2/012.
KM1 · CONTACTOR COIL AND AUXILIARY FEEDBACK
K1 NO 11–14 switches the KM1 24 V DC coil circuit. Coil A2 connects to the SITOP return.
KM1 auxiliary NO 13–14 routes a separate +24 V feed to CPU X10:8 / DI a.1 / I0.1.
KM1 NC 21–22 routes to I0.4 through XT2 on A2/010. Main poles remain unused.
S1 · START REQUEST
NO 13–14 routes the XT1 +24 V distribution to A1 DI a.2 / I0.2 at X10:9.
The contact is shown in its normal position. Request handling is assigned in PLC logic outside this example.
S2 · STOP REQUEST
NC 21–22 routes the XT1 +24 V distribution to A1 DI a.3 / I0.3 at X10:10.
The contact is shown in its normal position. Request handling is assigned in PLC logic outside this example.
This is an operational stop request input. Emergency-stop and safety circuits are outside scope.
I0.2 receives Start, I0.3 receives Stop, and I0.4 reads KM1 NC feedback through XT2.
XT2 · KM1 NORMALLY CLOSED FEEDBACK
X5 passes +24 V from XT1 to KM1:21 on A2/007.
X6 passes KM1:22 to A1 X10:11 / DI a.4 / I0.4 on A2/005.
I0.1 is the separate NO feedback channel. The two inputs can be compared in PLC logic outside this example.
Incoming L · X7:1
Incoming N · X8:1
From X21 → X9:1
XT3 · PS1 AC INPUT BOUNDARY
XT3 presents separate line, neutral and protective-earth terminals for the SITOP input.
Upstream source, isolation, protective devices, conductor sizing and cabinet bonding are outside scope.
XT2:3 · K1 NORMALLY CLOSED STATUS
K1:12 comes from the normally closed branch of the changeover contact on A2/006.
X10 passes that signal to A1 X10:12 / DI a.5 / I0.5 on A2/005.
I0.5 describes the K1 contact circuit. KM1 auxiliary feedback remains on I0.1 and I0.4.
I0.5 reads K1 NC status, I0.6 reads B2 OUT1, and I0.7 receives the XT7 operational permissive.
XT4 · PN2070 PRESSURE SENSOR SIGNALS
X11 passes B2 OUT2 to AI0. The analog branch assumes the sensor is configured for 0–10 V.
X12 passes B2 OUT1 to I0.6. The digital branch assumes PNP switching mode and leaves the setpoint open.
The two signal nets stay separate. This model records wiring and does not implement pressure thresholds or IO-Link.
XT5 · IFS204 FIELD CABLE TERMINALS
X13 and X14 pass the separate +24 V and 0 V feeds from XT1 to B1.
X15 passes B1 switching output to A1 DI a.0 / I0.0.
W-B1 core IDs 1, 3 and 4 match the sensor pins shown on A2/003. Cable selection remains open.
X16:2 · common
X17:2 · normally closed
X18:2 · normally open
K2 · REMOTE STATUS RELAY OUTPUT
A1 X12:4 / DQ a.1 / Q0.1 feeds K2:A1. K2:A2 returns to PS1 0 V.
K2 changeover terminals 11, 12 and 14 route separately to XT6 on A2/016.
XT6 · DRY CHANGEOVER OUTPUT
XT6 provides common, normally closed and normally open contact boundaries. External supply and load are unassigned.
The static net model preserves each contact terminal separately. Relay actuation is outside scope.
Q0.1 drives the K2 remote status relay. The output function is assigned in PLC logic outside this example.
XT7 · EXTERNAL OPERATIONAL PERMISSIVE INTERFACE
X19:2 · +24 V feed to external contact
X20:2 · switched signal from external contact
X20 routes the external contact signal to A1 X10:14 / DI a.7 / I0.7.
An external dry contact would bridge X19:2 and X20:2 when closed. The field device is outside this example.
This input is an operational permissive. Its logic and any safety circuit remain outside scope.
XT8 · PROTECTIVE CONDUCTOR ENTRY
Incoming PE · X21:1
Protective conductor route: X21 → X9 → PS1:PE.
Rail and enclosure bonding details belong to the installation design.

XT11:1 is taken downstream of X2 on the Branch B positive conductor.
XT11:2 is taken downstream of X4 on the Branch B return conductor.
The terminals document measurement access. No instrument or test result is assigned.
H1 · EXTERNALLY POWERED ANNUNCIATOR
XT12:1 feeds the K3 dry common on A2/020.
K3 normally open contact feeds H1. XT12:2 is the external return.
The external supply, protection and cable are unassigned. No connection to the SITOP return is modeled.
